One plan the whole team can read

Projects, dates and decisions sit together, so the plan answers questions before anyone has to ask them.

  • Milestones with dates

    Group tasks under a milestone with a due date. The plan shows what is due this week and what can wait.

  • Decisions beside the work

    Note why you chose an approach on the task itself. Months later the reason is one click away, not buried in chat.

  • A plan you can share

    Send clients a read-only link to the live plan. They follow progress without an account or a status meeting.

  • A Friday summary

    Each Friday, Acme emails everyone what they finished and what comes next. Nobody has to write the update.

Questions before you start

Something else on your mind? The help centre has step-by-step guides.

Do I need a credit card to start?

No. The Starter plan is free for teams of up to five people. You add a card only when you move to Team.

Can people outside my team see a plan?

Only if you share it. A share link gives read-only access to one project, and you can turn it off at any time.

Can I bring in work from a spreadsheet?

Yes. Paste rows from any spreadsheet into a project and Acme turns each row into a task, keeping your columns as fields.

What happens to my plans if I cancel?

Your projects stay readable, and you can export each one to CSV or Markdown from its settings.
